# Contibute

Welcome everyone!
This is simply a personal site, and I don't expect much of an following,
but anyone is welcome to help out.
You can contribute by creating issues (and pull requests solving issues)
that address what you want to work on.

Please follow the Code of Conduct while interacting in the community.
Additionaly be aware that proposed additions, ideas or changes may not be accepted,
though I will provide a reason for all responses, both positive and negative.

*Note: this doc is a placeholder and is incomplete,*
*It will be expanded as needed if things come up.*

Also welcome to reach out with any more questions, regarding moderator opportunities,
 or other unaddresed things, at [`contact@librarianofstars.ca`](mailto:contact@librarianofstars.ca).
